primary_claim.location: Results: change in competitive fitness; Figure 2 and Table 2
primary_claim.finding: The primary study explicitly compares fitness change on live and heat-killed parasites after 16 generations and concludes that elevated host defence had no measurable cost.

official_data.location: COREE fitness data.xls, verified MD5 receipt
official_data.finding: The verified workbook contains background, treatment, generation, replicate, assay-pathogen, and in/out competition-count fields used for the reported cost test.

records.named_gap: A proposal to test whether defence evolution has a fitness cost in parasite-present versus parasite-absent conditions repeats the primary study's explicit design and reported comparison.

outcomes.positive: Reproducing no measurable cost would only repeat the published conclusion.
outcomes.null: A null or imprecise reanalysis would not supply a distinct scientific consequence.
outcomes.contrary: A changed estimate would require a new predeclared question and specialist review before challenging the published result.

primary_claim.finding: The primary report manipulated genotypic and stem-height trait diversity, collected non-destructive productivity measures over time, but reports its stated treatment model for the October 2012 endpoint with block as a random factor.

official_data.location: Both CSVs, verified MD5 receipts, and bounded headers
official_data.finding: The repeated CSV has 576 rows over eight dates, six blocks, and 12 plots but only macrofaunal abundance fields; the separate endpoint CSV contains October plant-performance fields, not repeated plant-performance outcomes.

records.named_gap: The proposed time-aware test of plant performance fails because the only repeated observations are macrofaunal counts, while the claimed plant-performance outcomes are endpoint-only.

outcomes.positive: No valid time-aware plant-performance result is permitted without repeated plant-performance observations.
outcomes.null: No valid null result is permitted without repeated plant-performance observations.
outcomes.contrary: No valid contrary result is permitted without repeated plant-performance observations.

primary_claim.finding: The primary study describes 10 young and 10 old horses, multiple fascicles per tendon, and a lower cycles-to-failure result for aged fascicles.

official_data.location: Verified raw ZIP inventory and README
official_data.finding: The raw ZIP MD5 matches and lists 1,800-cycle files for nine horse identifiers; it does not provide a complete 20-horse cycles-to-failure analysis set for the reported age comparison.

records.named_gap: The proposed horse-level reanalysis fails because the verified archive is an incomplete subset relative to the reported 10-young/10-old cycles-to-failure comparison.

outcomes.positive: No valid horse-level result is permitted from the incomplete analysis subset.
outcomes.null: No valid null result is permitted from the incomplete analysis subset.
outcomes.contrary: No valid contrary result is permitted from the incomplete analysis subset.

next_permitted_action: Retain all three rejections and issue the bounded System-1 redesign/stop verdict for this V3 route; do not source another trio until a new source-selection policy is explicitly specified.
